tools.name: VMware
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Virtualization provides a migration path from VMware, consolidating VMs and containers on a single platform. Reduces licensing costs and eliminates vendor lock-in.

tools.name: AWS
tools.redHatPositioning: ROSA (Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS) provides managed OpenShift on AWS. RHEL is available on AWS Marketplace with commit drawdown. Ansible Automation Platform manages AWS infrastructure.

tools.name: Microsoft Azure
tools.redHatPositioning: ARO (Azure Red Hat OpenShift) provides managed OpenShift on Azure. RHEL is a first-class Azure VM image. Ansible manages Azure resources natively.

tools.name: Google Cloud
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Dedicated on GCP provides managed OpenShift. RHEL on Google Cloud with Marketplace integration. OpenShift Virtualization on Google Baremetal with NetApp Volumes.

tools.name: Kubernetes
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift IS enterprise Kubernetes with added security, CI/CD, monitoring, and multi-cluster management. Migration from vanilla K8s to OpenShift adds enterprise support and lifecycle management.

tools.name: Docker
tools.redHatPositioning: Podman provides a daemonless, rootless alternative to Docker. RHEL includes Podman, Buildah, and Skopeo as container tools. OpenShift uses CRI-O runtime.

tools.name: Terraform
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible Automation Platform provides agentless infrastructure automation. Ansible can orchestrate Terraform or replace it entirely for configuration management and provisioning.

tools.name: Jenkins
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Pipelines (Tekton) provides cloud-native CI/CD built into OpenShift. OpenShift GitOps (Argo CD) for declarative deployments.

tools.name: Splunk
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible integrates with Splunk for automated incident response and remediation. RHEL Insights feeds into Splunk for infrastructure monitoring.

tools.name: ServiceNow
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible Automation Platform has certified ServiceNow collection for automated ticket management, CMDB updates, and incident remediation workflows.

tools.name: Datadog
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift integrates with Datadog for application monitoring. Ansible automates Datadog agent deployment and configuration across infrastructure.

tools.name: GitLab
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Pipelines and GitOps provide native CI/CD on OpenShift. Red Hat Developer Hub integrates with GitLab for developer portal workflows.

tools.name: PagerDuty
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible Automation Platform integrates with PagerDuty for automated incident response. Event-Driven Ansible can trigger remediation from PagerDuty alerts.

tools.name: HashiCorp Vault
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift integrates with Vault for secrets management. Ansible manages Vault configuration and policy deployment.

tools.name: Kafka
tools.redHatPositioning: AMQ Streams (Strimzi) provides Kafka on OpenShift with operator-managed lifecycle. Ansible automates Kafka cluster provisioning.

tools.name: Oracle
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL is certified on Oracle Cloud. Oracle Cloud Marketplace Publisher Agreement signed — Red Hat products available for purchase directly. OpenShift runs on OCI.

tools.name: SUSE
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL provides superior lifecycle management, ecosystem breadth, and enterprise support. CentOS-to-RHEL migration path. Insights provides proactive risk assessment.

tools.name: Canonical
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL provides predictable lifecycle, certified ISV ecosystem, and enterprise compliance. Convert Ubuntu workloads to RHEL for consistent enterprise support.

tools.name: Ansible
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible Automation Platform provides enterprise automation with RBAC, audit logging, and certified content. Event-Driven Ansible enables reactive automation.

tools.name: Puppet
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible provides agentless configuration management as a Puppet alternative. Ansible Automation Platform eliminates the need for agent deployment and PKI infrastructure.

tools.name: Chef
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible provides agentless alternative to Chef. No Ruby dependency, YAML-based playbooks are more accessible. Ansible Automation Platform offers enterprise governance.

tools.name: Dynatrace
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift integrates with Dynatrace for full-stack monitoring. Ansible automates Dynatrace deployment. OpenShift includes built-in monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

tools.name: Jira
tools.redHatPositioning: Ansible Automation Platform integrates with Jira for automated ticket workflows. Red Hat Developer Hub provides Jira integration for developer portal.

tools.name: Elasticsearch
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift provides certified Elasticsearch operators for log aggregation. OpenShift Logging (based on Vector/Loki) offers integrated alternative. Ansible manages Elasticsearch clusters.

tools.name: Nginx
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift includes HAProxy-based ingress by default. Red Hat 3scale API Management provides API gateway capabilities beyond basic reverse proxy.

tools.name: MongoDB
tools.redHatPositioning: MongoDB has certified OpenShift operator for deployment on OpenShift. Ansible automates MongoDB provisioning and configuration.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.redHatPositioning: Crunchy PostgreSQL operator is certified on OpenShift. RHEL ships PostgreSQL packages. Ansible manages PostgreSQL deployment and configuration.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Pipelines and GitOps integrate with GitHub for CI/CD. Red Hat Developer Hub provides GitHub integration for developer portal and software catalog.

tools.name: Tableau
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL provides certified platform for Tableau Server deployment. Ansible automates Tableau infrastructure provisioning and scaling.

tools.name: SAP
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL for SAP Solutions is the #1 certified Linux platform for SAP HANA and S/4HANA. Ansible for SAP provides automated deployment and lifecycle management.

tools.name: Python
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL provides long-term supported Python runtimes. OpenShift provides Python S2I builders and developer tools for containerized Python applications.

tools.name: Go
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift provides Go S2I builders. Many OpenShift components (Kubernetes, etcd, CRI-O) are built in Go, making OpenShift the natural platform for Go microservices.

tools.name: Java
tools.redHatPositioning: Red Hat build of OpenJDK provides supported Java runtimes. Quarkus (Red Hat-led) delivers supersonic Java on Kubernetes. JBoss EAP provides enterprise Java app server.

tools.name: Node.js
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift provides Node.js S2I builders and UBI-based Node.js runtime images. Developer Hub templates accelerate Node.js microservice development.

tools.name: Redis
tools.redHatPositioning: Redis operators on OpenShift provide managed Redis clusters with persistence, HA, and backup. Eliminates managed cloud Redis lock-in.

tools.name: Cassandra
tools.redHatPositioning: Run Cassandra on OpenShift with operator-managed lifecycle. OpenShift provides consistent deployment across hybrid cloud for distributed databases.

tools.name: MySQL
tools.redHatPositioning: MariaDB ships with RHEL as the default SQL database. OpenShift provides MySQL and MariaDB operators for containerized database deployment.

tools.name: RabbitMQ
tools.redHatPositioning: AMQ Broker provides enterprise JMS/AMQP messaging on OpenShift. Red Hat Integration includes messaging, API management, and data transformation.

tools.name: Temporal
tools.redHatPositioning: Run Temporal on OpenShift for durable workflow orchestration. Ansible Automation Platform provides an alternative for infrastructure and operations workflows.

tools.name: Airflow
tools.redHatPositioning: Run Airflow on OpenShift AI for data pipeline orchestration alongside ML workloads. OpenShift provides the Kubernetes infrastructure Airflow runs on.

tools.name: Istio
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift Service Mesh is the supported distribution of Istio on OpenShift. Provides mTLS, traffic management, and observability with enterprise support.

tools.name: ArgoCD
tools.redHatPositioning: Red Hat OpenShift GitOps is the supported distribution of Argo CD. Provides declarative GitOps delivery for Kubernetes resources across clusters.

tools.name: Helm
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift supports Helm charts natively. Developer Hub provides Helm-based templates for standardized application scaffolding.

tools.name: Okta
tools.redHatPositioning: RHEL IdM (FreeIPA) provides enterprise identity management that integrates with Okta via SAML/OIDC federation. Red Hat build of Keycloak provides SSO federation.

tools.name: Rancher
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift provides enterprise Kubernetes with built-in CI/CD, security, and observability that Rancher requires as add-ons. ACM provides multi-cluster management across hybrid environments.

tools.name: Snowflake
tools.redHatPositioning: OpenShift AI connects analytics workloads to Snowflake data. Run data engineering and ML pipelines on OpenShift that pull from and write to Snowflake.
